baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا
baseline_models.mechanism: The event-day stirs a still population, regathers every dispersed person, and the immediate fa-clause turns that assembly into delivery of consequential news about intentional acts.

activation_trace.role: The image of a severe event-day supplies the temporal crisis in which the mechanism activates.
Stirring what was still supplies reactivation rather than mere relocation.
Joining the dispersed supplies the comprehensive assembly on which disclosure operates.
Consequential news that is brought and delivered makes disclosure the assembly's immediate function.
Intentional action defines the report's accountable content.

changed_reading.before: A generic resurrection is followed by information about past deeds.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection is a purpose-built disclosure assembly: all actors are reactivated and recomposed so their own intentional production can be delivered back to them as consequential news.

baseline_models.mechanism: Exact enumeration persists outside the agents' recall. Their loss or abandonment of the deeds changes access on the human side but does not alter the witnessed inventory.

activation_trace.role: Counting to completion supplies a preserved itemized inventory.
Loss of a formerly held remembrance supplies the human-side access failure.
Presence with direct observation prevents the inventory from depending on the actors' memory.

changed_reading.before: God remembers what people happen to forget.
changed_reading.after: The verse contrasts two record systems: fallible self-access and an independently witnessed, fully enumerated inventory that survives the actors' loss of access.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَمِيعًا ... أَحْصَىٰهُ ... عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse scales from every person gathered as a complete whole to every reportable thing encompassed and witnessed. Totality therefore operates at both population and item level.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness without missing parts supplies population-level completeness.
Exhaustive counting resolves the complete population into accountable particulars.
Encompassing all parts removes any residual gap in scope.
Anything knowable and reportable supplies the smallest open-ended unit of the scope.
Declaration grounded in knowledge turns comprehensive observation into admissible disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts one undifferentiated mass gathered for judgment.
changed_reading.after: The mass gathering is simultaneously an item-level audit: no person is absent from the whole and no reportable particular dissolves into the crowd.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening heard complaint and two-party exchange make the later count and witness contemporaneous reception, not a retrospective reconstruction. Contested speech enters the record while it is occurring.

activation_trace.role: Present observation anchors the focus reading in live witness.
Exhaustive enumeration is the focus mechanism sharpened by the heard exchange.
Repeated auditory perception supplies direct reception of the disputed utterance.
An uttered statement supplies a concrete kind of event that can enter the inventory.
Back-and-forth speech supplies a relational sequence rather than an isolated sentence.

structural_cues: 58:1 surrounds a complaint and a two-party exchange with repeated divine hearing and closes with hearing and sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heard speech and exchanged turns; I infer that live reception feeds the later enumerated disclosure. A live alternative is that hearing and final witness remain parallel assurances without implying one record process.

changed_reading.before: The divine count is an abstract archive consulted at resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The count is accumulated under live witness: even contested dialogue is received as it unfolds and can later be disclosed without dependence on human recollection.

context_deltas.mechanism: A false relational utterance is named, repeated by return, and followed by concrete repair. This makes speech itself an intentional production within بِمَا عَمِلُوا, not merely commentary surrounding deeds.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action is the focus category expanded to include consequential utterance.
Delivered news returns the speech-act and its consequences to its producers.
Saying or attributing what is not so supplies the operative false speech-act.
Falsehood and invalidity specify why the utterance changes social reality wrongly.
Return after an initial act supplies recurrence and the transition into required repair.

structural_cues: 58:2 names the utterance false; 58:3 links return to what was said with a concrete release before contact and closes with knowledge of what people do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false saying, return, and embodied repair; I infer that the utterance functions as an accountable deed. The live alternative is that عَمِلُوا refers only to the later compliance or noncompliance, with the saying retained as a separate category.

changed_reading.before: They are informed chiefly about overt physical conduct.
changed_reading.after: They are informed about acts that can be made in speech: a false designation, its recurrence, and the repair it obligated all belong to the produced record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Private counsel partitions people into supposedly closed clusters, but the progression from three and five to less and more removes every scale boundary. جَمِيعًا now reads as the opening and recomposition of every private micro-assembly into one disclosed whole.

activation_trace.role: Regathering the dispersed anchors the changed reading in the focus assembly.
Delivered news makes the opened clusters answerable for their contents.
Secret counsel supplies the apparently closed social unit that the focus gathering opens.
The number three supplies one bounded private cluster.
The number five supplies a second cluster and begins the scale expansion.
Nearer or fewer than the stated groups removes a lower size boundary.
Increase in number removes the upper size boundary.
Uncovered knowledge at both ends of the ayah encloses every cluster within awareness.

structural_cues: 58:7 moves from three and five to less and more, asserts accompaniment wherever they are, then repeats informing them of what they did and closes with every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies private groups, exhaustive size variation, accompaniment, and repeated disclosure; I infer that total gathering dissolves privacy partitions. The live alternative is that the numbers assert omniscience without adding a social recomposition image to جَمِيعًا.

changed_reading.before: All individuals are collected from dispersed locations.
changed_reading.after: Every supposedly sealed conversational cluster, from the smallest upward, is opened and recomposed into a single accountable assembly whose hidden contents are delivered back.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated secret coordination culminates in speech within the self. The focus report can therefore reach beneath publicly completed behavior to covert coordination and the self-justifying account that sustains it.

activation_trace.role: Intentional production anchors the extension from overt deed to covertly organized conduct.
A delivered report makes otherwise private coordination confrontable.
Secret counsel supplies covert interpersonal coordination.
Speech held within and not outwardly shown supplies the private self-account.
What is in the inner self supplies the location of that unpublicized saying.
Return after prohibition makes the covert conduct a repeated pattern rather than a stray thought.

structural_cues: 58:8 moves from prohibited private counsel to renewed counsel and then to what they say within themselves about delayed punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies renewed secret counsel and inner saying; I infer that these organize the intentional conduct later reported. A live alternative is that only spoken counsel counts under عمل while the inner saying merely exposes attitude.

changed_reading.before: The report concerns externally observable completed deeds.
changed_reading.after: The report can expose the covert organization of a deed and its inward justificatory script, not only its public surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: Making room and rising are small spatial adjustments that redistribute access and rank. Their placement under knowledge of what people do makes the focus inventory socially granular, not restricted to spectacular offenses.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action anchors ordinary spatial responses within the focus deed category.
Itemized enumeration lets small social adjustments remain distinct in the inventory.
Opening space supplies a minute action that changes another person's access.
Rising and moving from a sitting place supplies a second embodied micro-action.
Knowledge of the report and the matter's interior connects these gestures to informed appraisal.

structural_cues: 58:11 brackets commands to make room and rise with the closing statement that God is aware of what people do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spatial commands and a closing knowledge-of-deeds formula; I infer that compliance in minor social choreography is individually retained. The live alternative is that the closing formula functions only as general exhortation.

changed_reading.before: The enumerated deeds are chiefly major transgressions.
changed_reading.after: The inventory remains fine-grained enough to retain ordinary acts of making room or refusing to move, because those small spatial choices distribute dignity and access.

context_deltas.mechanism: False oaths become a practiced shield and are replayed when all are raised. Human forgetting can thus coexist with a rehearsed counter-record: the divine report defeats not blankness alone but a protective narrative still performed before God.

activation_trace.role: Loss of remembrance is the focus state revised from simple blankness to displaced access.
Consequential news supplies the authoritative account that breaks the shield.
Swearing supplies the practiced defensive speech form.
Contradiction of truth specifies the oath as a counter-record rather than evidence.
The oath sense of the right hand supplies the object deliberately adopted for protection.
A protective shield supplies the concealment function assigned to the oaths.
The same swearing before God reenacts the earthly defense after resurrection.
Supposition supplies the self-deceptive confidence that the defense still stands.
The closing identification as liars exposes the replayed defense as false.

structural_cues: 58:14 introduces knowing false oaths, 58:16 calls the oaths a shield, and 58:18 repeats the focus day-raising-all frame while showing the same oath behavior before God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an oath shield and its resurrection replay; I infer that forgetting may involve displacement by a rehearsed false account. The live alternative is a literal memory lapse alongside an independently habitual lie, without mnemonic replacement.

changed_reading.before: They have no usable memory of what they did, so the report merely restores missing facts.
changed_reading.after: They may retain and reenact a false protective story while losing the deeds it masks; the report punctures that performed counter-memory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Domination gathers people into a faction and causes remembrance to be lost. نَسُوهُ can therefore describe socially organized attentional capture, while divine enumeration preserves what the captured group no longer retrieves.

activation_trace.role: Loss of remembrance anchors the changed causal reading in the focus.
Preserved enumeration supplies the record that survives induced forgetting.
Domination, seizure, and gathering supply an external capture mechanism.
Keeping or recovering something after forgetting supplies the displaced content.
A group consolidated around one position supplies the social container of the forgetting.

structural_cues: 58:19 gives a causal sequence: seizure, caused forgetting of remembrance, then identification as a faction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies domination, caused forgetting, and factional grouping; I infer a social-attentional cause for the focus forgetting. The live alternative is that 58:19 concerns forgetting remembrance of God specifically and should not govern forgetting deeds in 58:6.

changed_reading.before: Forgetting is an isolated cognitive weakness of each individual.
changed_reading.after: Forgetting may be produced and stabilized by capture into a collective orientation; the divine count preserves what that social system suppresses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later writing language gives the focus enumeration durable juridical force: a count can function as a binding register that establishes outcome and affiliation, not merely as perfect recollection.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive enumeration anchors the proposed register in the focus.
Writing that establishes a binding decree supplies juridical force to the record image.
Entering an identity in a register supplies durable classification at the human interior.

structural_cues: 58:21 uses divine writing for an assured outcome, while 58:22 places divine writing in hearts before naming final affiliation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding writing and registered identity; I infer that these images lend enacted durability to أَحْصَىٰهُ. A live alternative is that the two writing clauses concern decree and faith only, with no register-like sharpening of the focus count.

changed_reading.before: God's count is flawless mental retention.
changed_reading.after: The count behaves like an authoritative register: exhaustive knowledge is fixed into a determination that can classify actors and establish consequences.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes remote lexical branches rather than translating the clause directly. It remains anchored in the paired focus roots ح ص ي and ن س ي and clarifies their opposed handling of particulars. Downstream prose should present it only as a tactile analogy, not as the lexical meaning of أَحْصَىٰهُ وَنَسُوهُ.

activation_trace.role: Pebbles supply a discrete, countable material image for otherwise abstract enumeration.
Discarded and disregarded scraps supply the human treatment of deeds as negligible remnants.
A closed handful tentatively supplies the retention of many small countable units together.

changed_reading.before: One mind remembers an abstract total that other minds forget.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, people throw their deeds aside like worthless scraps while the divine inventory retains each small particular like a separately countable stone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the movement branch of ن ب ء beneath a form normally read as informing. It remains anchored in يُنَبِّئُهُم and is reinforced by the focus sequence of sending or raising, gathering, then notification. Downstream prose should call it a spatialized reading of disclosure, not claim that the verb literally means the deeds travel.

activation_trace.role: Coming from one place to another spatializes the report as an arrival at its addressees.
Sending and directing supplies the outward movement paired with the report's return movement.
Their own intentional production supplies what confronts them upon arrival.

changed_reading.before: God verbally tells them facts about a remote past.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, disclosure has spatial force: after they are sent forth and assembled, the consequential news of their own production arrives back at them and closes the distance they created from it.

strongest_changes: The exact echo in 58:7 turns total gathering into the opening of every private conversational cluster, regardless of size.
The false-oath sequence in 58:14-18 revises forgetting from mere blankness into possible displacement by a rehearsed protective counter-record.
The causal sequence in 58:19 makes forgetting potentially induced and factionally stabilized rather than merely individual.
The opening heard dispute and later micro-social commands make the inventory both live and granular: speech, inner coordination, and small spatial choices remain accountable acts.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses a full evidence mechanism into one sequence: reactivation, total assembly, delivered report, exhaustive enumeration, failed human recall, and present witness. Context repeatedly tests that mechanism on speech that is disputed, private, inward, shielded by oaths, or socially normalized.
remaining_uncertainties: نَسُوهُ can still denote ordinary cognitive lapse, deliberate neglect, or contextually induced displacement; the trace keeps all three live.
The extension of بِمَا عَمِلُوا to inner saying is plausible through the counsel sequence but less secure than its extension to spoken speech-acts.
The pebble, discarded-scrap, and arriving-report models are controlled material analogies from branch inventories, not direct translations.
